name: Firefighters Code Red
storyline:
In Firefighters Code Red, the dev team draws on their experience from Firefighting Simulator – The Squad to send you to over 30 different locations across North America. Suit up and head exactly where everyone else is fleeing from: straight into the fire, through blazing buildings, thick smoke, and collapsing structures.

The game simulates fire with the same intensity it has in real life: it eats through rooms, spreads dynamically, and strikes back. Backdrafts detonate in an instant, grease fires punish the wrong extinguishing agent without mercy, and smoke thickens into a life-threatening zone of zero visibility.

Whether it's electronics, chemicals, or uncontrolled chain reactions - every fire plays by its own rules. In Firefighters Code Red, fire spreads unpredictably, burns more fiercely both indoors and outdoors, and leaves visible destruction behind. And the danger doesn't stop at your front door: flames can spread to smaller wooded areas too, throwing new challenges your way.

Take on the challenge alone or call in your squad: in cross-platform co-op multiplayer, you plan your mission together, split up the tasks, and work as a coordinated team. Can you count on each other when every second matters?

Get behind the wheel of authentic fire trucks and use a wide range of realistic equipment. Every tool has its moment – every call demands the right decision at the right time.

Random elements keep every call unpredictable. Whether the number and location of victims change, fires break out in new places, or escape routes that were open suddenly get blocked: what you learned on your last call can help you - but you should never count on it.
summary: When fear takes over, your mission begins: in Firefighters Code Red you battle flames, smoke, and the clock - alone or in cross-platform multiplayer with your squad.
